scope: Every @objc desktop action in App, WorkspaceController and Studio*.swift. This mapping guards review completeness; passing it is not execution evidence.

App.changeLanguage.behavior: Select System/English/Simplified Chinese for next launch.

App.openAuthorProfile.behavior: Expose the author/project website through the native About window.

App.showAbout.behavior: Show version, author, license and project website.

StudioActions.authorTimeChanged.behavior: Commit exact native time without inventing capture FPS.

StudioActions.cameraFOVChanged.behavior: Edit horizontal FOV and preserve the camera raster.

StudioActions.cameraPreset.behavior: Choose a world-up standard perspective orientation.

StudioActions.cameraTransformChanged.behavior: Commit finite XYZ and normalized WXYZ.

StudioActions.cancelLoading.behavior: Cancel an obsolete source load without replacing the current document.

StudioActions.createCamera.behavior: Create a separate authored camera from the current view.

StudioActions.deleteCamera.behavior: Delete the authored camera with undo history.

StudioActions.deleteCameraKey.behavior: Remove an authored camera key with undo history.

StudioActions.exportScreenshot.behavior: Export completed viewport or native calibrated image pixels.

StudioActions.exportWorkspace.behavior: Export the current native GTK workbench before the save dialog.

StudioActions.findID.behavior: Find the exact signed 64-bit identity in its owning object.

StudioActions.fitTimeline.behavior: Fit source and authored timeline extents.

StudioActions.focusSelection.behavior: Frame selected geometry/cameras while retaining view orientation.

StudioActions.importCameras.behavior: Import compatible camera-only GSV into the authoring session.

StudioActions.jumpCameraKey.behavior: Choose a camera key and seek its time.

StudioActions.lookThroughSelection.behavior: Explicitly look through the inspected camera.

StudioActions.loopChanged.behavior: Toggle looping inside the active preview range.

StudioActions.navigationToolChanged.behavior: Choose select/orbit/pan/dolly with native cursor feedback.

StudioActions.nearClipFieldChanged.behavior: Change near clip within declared scene-unit limits.

StudioActions.openDocument.behavior: Open one local GSV with the native file dialog.

StudioActions.pivotSelection.behavior: Set the pivot from selection without changing the camera.

StudioActions.pivotView.behavior: Set the pivot using bounded visible-depth sampling.

StudioActions.previewRateChanged.behavior: Commit a valid positive preview-units/second rate.

StudioActions.rangeChanged.behavior: Commit or disable an ordered in/out preview range.

StudioActions.recordCameraKeyframe.behavior: Record the current camera at committed playhead time.

StudioActions.redoCamera.behavior: Redo a camera edit independently of view navigation.

StudioActions.renderSliderChanged.behavior: Change browsing size/opacity/exposure independently of scientific capture.

StudioActions.resetCamera.behavior: Frame the whole scene with the default free camera.

StudioActions.resolutionChanged.behavior: Choose 100/75/50 percent preview raster without sampling identities.

StudioActions.retimeCameraKey.behavior: Retime one key atomically without collisions.

StudioActions.undoCamera.behavior: Undo a camera edit independently of view navigation.

StudioActions.upAxisChanged.behavior: Choose one of six signed world up axes.

StudioActions.viewChanged.behavior: Follow a selected source or user camera.

StudioComparison.actualPixels.behavior: Display one image pixel per display backing pixel.

StudioComparison.compareSelectedObservat.behavior: Compare a selected observation through its linked render view.

StudioComparison.previewSelectedRenderVi.behavior: Preview a selected render view without scores.

StudioComparison.selectRenderView.behavior: Choose an explicit render view and activate its space/clock.

StudioInspector.copySelection.behavior: Copy displayed source attributes to the native clipboard.

StudioInspector.inspectorDidScroll.behavior: Keep the native inspector scrolling position while refreshing values.

StudioInspector.makePrimarySelection.behavior: Choose a primary member without changing mixed membership.

StudioPreviewControls.pathOpacityChanged.behavior: Change complete trajectory opacity as a percentage.

StudioPreviewControls.trajectoryDensityC.behavior: Choose 1–100 percent nested deterministic path density.

WorkspaceController.objectVisibilityChan.behavior: Toggle one supported source or authored object.

WorkspaceController.outlineDoubleClick.behavior: Activate a camera/render view or another source space/clock.
